# Returns policy
FACT: Customers may return unopened products within 30 days of purchase.
Returns require the original receipt and payment method.

# Customer support
FACT: Customer support is available Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 Eastern Time.
The support team handles product and account questions.

# Shipping
FACT: Standard domestic shipping normally takes three to five business days.
Expedited shipping is available at checkout.

# Warranty
FACT: Hardware products include a one-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects.
Accidental damage is not covered.

# Privacy
FACT: Account deletion requests are completed within 14 calendar days.
Identity verification is required before deletion.

# Billing
FACT: Monthly subscriptions renew on the calendar day on which they were purchased.
Invoices are emailed after successful payment.

# Service regions
FACT: The service is currently available in the United States and Canada.
Regional availability may change after a public announcement.

# Account security
FACT: Multi-factor authentication supports authenticator applications and security keys.
SMS is reserved for account recovery.

# Data exports
FACT: User data exports are delivered as a ZIP archive through a time-limited download link.
Exports may take up to 24 hours to prepare.

# Service status
FACT: Planned maintenance is announced at least 48 hours in advance on the status page.
Incident updates are posted on the same page.

# Employee discount override
